hits.name: Mantle cell lymphoma
hits.description: Mantle cell lymphoma is a rare form of malignant non-Hodgkin lymphoma affecting B lymphocytes in the lymph nodes in a region called the ``mantle zone''.

hits.name: Gastric Mantle Cell Lymphoma
hits.description: A mantle cell lymphoma that affects the stomach. It may arise as a solitary mass or it may be a component of multifocal lymphomatous polyposis of the gastrointestinal tract. It usually has an aggressive clinical course.

hits.name: Splenic Mantle Cell Lymphoma
hits.description: A mantle cell lymphoma occurring in the spleen.
